description: Zenodo publishes a structured workbook of drought impacts reported in Irish newspapers between 1733 and 2019. The researchers searched the Irish Newspaper Archive and coded reports by impact, timing, place and response, with locations at regional, county or finer scale where stated. The record lists an XLSM file under CC BY 4.0 and free public access. The data can inform historical water-supply, agriculture and social-vulnerability scenarios, especially where instrumental drought series are sparse. It is a record of what newspapers reported, not a complete count of every drought or a direct gauge of river flow. Reporting density and language may change across centuries, and impact dates may differ from publication dates. These caveats matter before assigning event frequency or comparing counties. The dataset complements data-uk-historic-droughts-agricultural-media-inventory-1975-2012, a separate media-derived inventory. No workbook or article PDF was downloaded.
